title: Delightful Turkish Delight Bake
description: A sweet and crunchy Turkish delight-inspired dessert, perfect for snacking. This crunchy treat combines the flavors of Turkish delight with the simplicity of a bake.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the Turkish Delight, brown sugar, and butter. Mix until well combined.
3. Add the flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
4. Roll out the dough to a thickness of 5mm.
5. Cut the dough into desired shapes or sizes.
6. Place the shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
8. Allow the bake to cool completely before serving.
